name: Claiming Arathi Basin
label: Quest
description: Claiming Arathi Basin: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The war against the Horde is quickly depleting our supplies, friend. It is vital to maintain control of Arathi Basin to keep the stream of resources flowing! Have you lent a hand in Arathi yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good work, soldier! Keep it up and we'll have the Horde running all the way back to Orgrimmar.
